Currently (in proof of work) there is a handful of producers, one relay and one builder.
What we have built here together enables to have infinite producers, a few trusted relays, connected to many builders.
What we are building next will enable infinite builders and make the relays disappear.
It's a good direction. To change the direction I think we need to come up with a better plan.
